'''Echo-97''' was a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] flew it from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[JanFathal]] to rendezvous with the warship ''[[Leveler]]''.<ref name="No Prisoners" />
